name: Ancient Statuette
summary: Along Ashenvale's northwestern shore, Talen seeks the Ancient Statuette he recovered from Zoram's sunken ruins. The night elf effigy came from a city lost beneath the waves.

sections.title: A Relic in the Shallows
sections.body: The sunken ruins of Zoram lie off northwestern Ashenvale. The pre-Sundering night elven city was lost beneath the waves ten thousand years ago. Recently, the explorer Talen surveyed the ruins from a small craft, searching for historical relics. Naga attacked and drove him ashore. In his flight, he left most of his belongings behind, including the ancient statuette he had dredged up. It lies on the tideline sand near his scuttled skiff.

sections.title: Secrets of Zoram
sections.body: Talen calls the statuette his most prized possession and the reason he braved the monster-infested coast. He believes the effigy can help decipher Zoram's architecture, history, and arcane secrets, all hidden beneath the surf of Zoram Strand.

faq.answer: The Ancient Statuette came from the sunken ruins of Zoram, an ancient night elven city off Ashenvale's northwestern coast.

faq.q: Who is looking for the statuette?
faq.answer: The night elf explorer Talen seeks the statuette. Naga attacked while he surveyed the submerged ruins by boat, and he dropped the relic on the beach as he fled.
Talen believes the statuette can help uncover Zoram's history and the secrets hidden in its ruins beneath the waves.

faq.q: Why are naga prowling around where it was found?
faq.answer: Naga have infested the coastal waters and ruins of Zoram Strand. They attack surface dwellers who venture near the sunken remains of their submerged territory.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the statuette as a fragment of Kaldorei civilization from before the Great Sundering, preserved under the sea for millennia.
As an Alliance member, you can help Talen document and reclaim night elven heritage from the naga encroaching along Ashenvale's coast.
